verdicts.evidence: The key phrases from "arrive before ten" to "on the field only" are all italic and underlined, but there are five of them, not six.
All five emphasised phrases are styled the same way, so "collected by four" looks the same as "labelled with their ingredients"; the finding is right about this even though it miscounts them as six.
The text reads "Please arrive before ten" without saying who it is for, "Parking is on the field only" without naming a field, and puts the raffle penalty in the middle of a sentence.
